_comment: Cell descriptor for layout/bin/compose-cell.py -- see layout/README.md
for the recipe this follows and layout/bias_core_pnp8_leg/ (issue #30/
PR #33) for the sibling proof cell this one is scaled down from. Issue
#36 (part of #34, itself a follow-on from #30/#4).
This is design/netlist/bias_core.spice's XQ1 and XQR devices: two
single-instance sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W3p40L3p40 units -- 'XQ1 VSS VSS
NA ...' (the matching 1x reference unit for the pnp8_leg's 8:1 emitter-
count ratio group) and 'XQR VSS VSS ER ...' (the VREF-leg unit). Both
tie collector AND base to VSS and are otherwise electrically
independent of each other (distinct emitter nets NA/ER) -- they are
housed in one composed cell here purely for layout convenience (one
shared common-centroid bjt_array call, one shared collector guard
ring), not because the schematic wires them together.
klt gen bjt_array (rows=1, cols=2, ratio=1, common_centroid, a shared
collector guard ring) draws both unit devices under ONE shared ring in
a single call -- Q0 is XQ1, Q1 is XQR.
SAME KNOWN GAP as layout/bias_core_pnp8_leg/, filed generically as
2AMLogic/klayout-tools#1894 (see that cell's own cell.json/README.md
for the full writeup): the collector guard ring's COLL_N/S/E/W ports
never receive a real licon/mcon contact from `klt gen-compose`'s
via-drop, and `klt extract` always recovers the collector as a
separate, unstrapped 'vsubs' node. Dropping COLL_* from this
cell.json's connectivity[]/pins[] (as pnp8_leg does) avoids that
failure mode and leaves 'vss' (both base pins, wired together -- see
below) and each device's own emitter (declare-only top-level pins
'na'/'er', never bussed to anything) DRC-clean, correctly separate,
and individually LVS-matchable against the design's own device cards
-- only the collector-to-VSS strap this cell's own LVS run against the
*unmodified* design/netlist/bias_core.spice reference still (honestly)
reports as a mismatch. Revisit once the upstream gap is fixed.
Routing: base 'metal' role (li1) with 'cross_block_layer_role: metal2'
(met1) for the one same-block self-net ('vss' bussing Q0_B and Q1_B),
which otherwise jogs directly over Q1_E's own drawn pad -- the same
cross-block bus routing example layout/bias_core_pnp8_leg/ used, just
with one same-block net here instead of two ('na'/'er' are each a
single-pin declare-only top-level pin, not a connectivity[] net, so
neither needs its own routing pass).
FULL-CELL ASSEMBLY PIN (issue #61): 'vss' is a real cross-sub-block net
-- bias_core's own global ground -- so #40's full-cell assembly needs it
externally reachable, not just bussed between Q0_B and Q1_B in here.
Promoting it needs a route OUT of the array, and `klt gen-compose`
refuses any leg to a non-tap port of a block whose guard/collector ring
is a CLOSED loop ('a route to its non-tap port would cross the ring's
own metal loop and merge this net with the ring's tap net') -- the same
silent-short failure mode 2AMLogic/klayout-tools#1894 describes, now
caught instead of drawn. So the ring is regenerated with a routing
opening on its N side (params.ring_gap_side/ring_gap_um/
ring_gap_offset_um), centred exactly on Q0_B's own x (4.01um; the ring's
N midpoint is 4.42um, hence offset -0.41um), and 'vss' escapes straight
north through it onto 'stub_vss' -- a plain declare-only li1 stub
(promo_stub.gds) parked clear of the array, PR #62's own promotion
technique with the ring opening added. Q0_B sits 2.67um below the
block's own north edge (y=1.7, bbox y1=4.37) and the opening is centred
on its x, so the escape riser is a straight northward run that crosses
no other pad.
COST OF THE OPENING, stated plainly: the collector ring is now a
C-shaped conductor, not a closed loop, so its substrate-isolation
function is interrupted at the 1.5um N-side opening. That is a real
floorplan change, not a free one -- but this ring is already NOT strapped
to VSS at all (the installed klt predates klayout-tools#1894's fix, so
`klt extract` still recovers it as a floating 'vsubs' node either way),
so the opening costs nothing this cell currently has. Revisit the side/
width, or close the ring again and route through a real COLL_* tap, once
the installed klt carries #1894's fix -- see README.md 'Upstream status'.
